children.body_en:
Behold — such a Creator is my Lord
Who holds all authority, my Lord
All the great ones, whomever one may name
Greater than them all is my Lord
No need of His depends on anyone
Nor is He beholden to anyone, my Lord
From nothingness He gave being its form
Such a Sustainer is my Lord
He is the Maker of all that is made
And the Hearer of every word, my Lord
Who has, anywhere, no like and no likeness
He is the Perfumer of those perfumes, my Lord
Every edifice of this world and the next
Of them all He is the Architect, my Lord
He is the Reader of unwritten pages
And the Knower of every secret, my Lord
Whether manifest or hidden or between
Of all He is aware, my Lord
Whether visible or concealed or in between
Of all He has full knowledge, my Lord
He keeps no partner in His kingdom
Partnerless, He is the King, my Lord
Not that His Oneness comes from weakness
In His single Being He is manifold, my Lord
He needs no one's friendship or help
Yet to those He is a friend, my Lord
What need is there to call on any other side?
In my own home He is beside me, my Lord
No change or alteration touches Him, O Rahman
Forever and ever He endures, my Lord

children.body_en:
Had the form of Muhammad ﷺ not been created,
God would not have created this world.
The whole world came into being for the sake of Muhammad's ﷺ countenance;
Muhammad ﷺ is the forefather of the entire world.
Prophethood ended with Muhammad ﷺ;
there is no prophet after Muhammad ﷺ.
At that time, only the light of Muhammad ﷺ existed in the world,
when there was not even a trace of Adam and Eve.
In form, though he was created last of all,
in meaning, he is the first of all.
Do not take him for God — undoubtedly, he is a servant;
all his other attributes are truly so.
Whether prophet, saint, or sinner —
Muhammad ﷺ is the leader of them all.
Whoever has accepted the faith of Muhammad ﷺ
is bound for Paradise, whether transgressor or pious.
Muhammad ﷺ is the guide who shows the misguided the straight path;
Muhammad ﷺ is the staff in the hand of the blind.
If there is light, it is the following of Muhammad ﷺ;
there is no other light in the world.
Muhammad ﷺ is the helper of the helpless;
Muhammad ﷺ is the cure for every afflicted one.
I, Rahman, am the sweeper of Muhammad's ﷺ court;
may God never separate me from this court.
